title: Falsy timestamp value 0 incorrectly rejected
description: Line 80 uses `body.get("t") or body.get("ts")` which treats timestamp=0 as falsy, causing fallback to "ts" or None. A POST with {"t": 0, ...} is rejected with BAD_REQUEST even though line 95 explicitly allows timestamp >= 0. Fix: use `body.get("t") if "t" in body else body.get("ts")` to check key presence rather than truthiness.
